commit.message:
task(bench,web): close the tasks whose PRs already landed

Four tasks were still active/draft with their acceptance criteria unticked even
though their work merged, and three of them said so in their own notes:

- bench-problem-leaderboard -> completed. #577 implemented it; the one criterion
  it recorded as unreachable from the data (an all-timeout cell, invisible
  because the publisher dropped runs:0 rows) was fixed by #578 and is pinned in
  the publisher's BATS suite.
- bench-solver-compare -> completed. Its note: 'can be marked completed once #577
  merges'. #577 is merged.
- bench-data-download -> completed. Its note: the last open criterion (the
  problem-page half) is met once #577 merges.
- type-check-the-islands -> completed. #580 widened tsconfig to the component
  directory and CI's existing tsc step runs it, so the check cannot be skipped.
- bench-algorithm-pages -> completed (#574), with a note that its checkboxes were
  never ticked during implementation so a reader can reopen it if a criterion was
  missed.
- bench-tier-a-campaign: left open. The tier published (index.json reports tier a,
  22 solvers, 12 problems), but 'raw TSV retained' and 'both budgets per cell'
  are not verifiable from here, so it gets a Status note rather than a tick.
